subject.title: Dynamic tool_call/tool_search invokes tools without validating input against the declared inputSchema

question: Should dynamic tool calls receive OpenClaw-owned soft schema errors at the bridge, or should OpenClaw update/adapt the upstream Pi runtime so direct and dynamic calls share one validator?
rationale: Both approaches can prevent invalid execution, but they create different long-term ownership and compatibility contracts for plugin, MCP, and client-provided tools.

options.title: Use the shared upstream boundary
options.body: Confirm Pi’s supported validation seam and adapt or update it so all relevant calls return the same structured failure.

options.title: Validate in the OpenClaw bridge
options.body: Add a narrowly scoped bridge validator only if upstream does not expose a suitable shared contract, with explicit parity tests for every affected call mode.

recommendation.title: Use the shared upstream boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm Pi’s supported validation seam and adapt or update it so all relevant calls return the same structured failure.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision depends on the Pi runtime’s intended tool-schema and execution contract.
